in_sanskrit.name: Imanvi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Imana's dwelling
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Imanvi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Imanvi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Imana’, which refers to the dwelling place of the goddess Imana. In Hindu mythology, Imana is a goddess of abundance and prosperity. The name Imanvi symbolizes the divine presence that resides within one's home and heart.
